slug: 2025-11-05 Review of Djibouti Data Protection Law

facts.fact: TechHive Advisory states that Djibouti's 156-article data-protection regime was enacted in June 2025 as part of the Digital Code; it gives no promulgation or commencement date.

TechHive Advisory states that the Digital Code's data-protection regime creates the National Commission for the Protection of Personal Data (CNDP), independent with administrative and financial autonomy; it does not say the commission has been constituted or its members appointed (date is the document's published date, 2025-11-05).
